sources.title: GitHub - Huzaifa-X/Whisper_small_openai_finetuned_on_arabic_language ...
sources.snippet: This project aims to perform Arabic speech recognition using the Whisper model, developed by OpenAI. We fine-tune the Whisper model on an Arabic speech dataset, leveraging the Hugging Face Transformers library. The trained model can transcribe Arabic speech audio into text with high accuracy.
